Gespage - Service continuity plan (Windows) – March 2017

3
1. Introduction 
For service continuity purposes, this document aims to detail the procedures to be set in case a 
failure of the print server hosting Gespage solution. 
 
This document is specific to the Windows server architecture. 
 
The architecture of Gespage solution is described in the administration manual. 
2. Service continuity plan 
To ensure a service continuity plan, it is advisable to host Gespage and the print server in a 
virtualized environment and set up a service continuity plan at the virtualization solution (VMware, 
Hyper-V type).

o ensure a service continuity plan, it is advisable to host Gespage and the print server in a 
virtualized environment and set up a service continuity plan at the virtualization solution (VMware, 
Hyper-V type). 
 
Indeed, from Windows Server 2012, Microsoft has removed the support of the cluster function for 
the role of the print server and recommends to use the native mechanisms of the virtualization 
solution. 
 
The backup of useful data for service continuity is explained in the backup plan. 
 
The detection of a failure at the active server is explained in the monitoring plan. 
2.1 Case of a virtualized server 
The following Microsoft blog provides the recommendations for implementing a high availability for 
Windows Server 2012 print servers in Hyper-V virtualization environment: 
http://blogs.msdn.com/b/clustering/archive/2012/10/30/10364265.aspx 
 
In another virtualization environment like VMware, it is recommended to refer to the 
recommendations of the environment. 
 
The procedure in case of failure detection of the active server is: 
- 
Restoring the backup VM 
- 
Restoring the backup of Gespage data base. 
2.2 Case of a non-virtualized server 
Gespage solution is compatible with the active/passive MS cluster architecture. 
 
Attention, this solution is not compatible with a print server installed on a Windows Server 2012. 
3. Backup plan 
Gespage daily saves its data base on the server. The backup file is saved to an adjustable path (by 
default to GespageCore \ db \ postgresql \ save in Gespage installation directory). 
 
Gespage backup file enables the configuration of Gespage database to be reset (includes the 
Gespage general configuration, the Gespage configuration of the printers, the configuration of the 
terminals and eTerminals, the user account

directory).

Gespage general configuration, the Gespage configuration of the printers, the configuration of the

Gespage - Service continuity plan (Windows) – March 2017

4
 
It is recommended to save Gespage backup daily to an external media and keep a history of at least 
one week. 
 
This backup does not include: 
- 
The configuration of the print queues in Windows/Linux. 
- 
The software installed by the application (Gespage, PostgreSQL database). 
- 
The spool files of the pending prints. 
3.1 Case of a virtualized server 
For virtualized configurations, it is recommended to keep an image of Gespage server after the 
installation and setup of the configuration are completed. 
 
Ii is then recommended to update above image in the following cases: 
- 
Upgrade of Gespage solution 
- 
Changing the printer queues configuration in Windows (adding a printer queue, 
modifying the print driver). 
3.2 Case of a non-virtualized server 
For Windows servers, there is an export tool for the configuration of printer queues, it enables an 
import to a new server. This export must be carried out at each change of the printer queues. 
 
The procedure provided by Microsoft for migration of print servers is available under: 
http://technet.microsoft.com/fr-fr/library/cc722360.aspx 
4. Monitoring plan 
The activity of the print server and Gespage solution may be monitored by following the status of the 
services in use. 
 
The lists of Gespage service are: 
- 
Gespage Print server: Management service of print queues 
- 
Gespage application server: Gespage central Service 
- 
Gespage eTerminal service: Service

- 
Gespage Print server: Management service of print queues 
-

- 
Gespage eTerminal service: Service used by Xerox eTerminals 
-

- 
Gespage Mobile service: Service used for the service of mobile printing. 
The services used by Gespage server are: 
- 
Windows print spooler 
- 
PostgreSQL database. 
5. Disaster recovery plan 
This plan deals with a disaster causing the unavailability of both Gespage solution and the print 
server despite the service continuity plan.
